hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker protocol hook that applies a volatility-based dynamic LP fee by simulating each swap to estimate the post-swap tick, then updating the pool fee via updateDynamicLPFee. It also collects a protocol fee on each swap using beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas, and supports optional MEV protection modules and post-swap pool extensions.
